WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AnsanFavorites2026#69086-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AnsanFavorites2026#69085-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오. 모든 참가자가 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지할 것을 강력히 권장합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ ## Please read the "[What is a Favorites Competition?](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AnsanFavorites2026#69106-favorites-what-is-a-favorites-competition)" tab before registering. If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AnsanFavorites2026#69086-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AnsanFavorites2026#69085-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering. All competitors are strongly encouraged to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request. Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.

items.information: **Português** Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Procure se divertir bastante! **English** It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - At the time of the awards, at the end of Sunday, we will draw some cubes for the competitors. Only win who is present and no one can win twice; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI0MjY2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8efbb86064c7715684b16e2c61c3057e7be46ee5/IMG_3706.jpeg) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI0MjY3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1d377905ca8a83b9f95df9338d24320f682f5446/IMG_3705.jpeg) 🇧🇷 **(Português) Brasileiro:** Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba Inscrever. Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo neste [vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wLE2OFf9nh8). ❗️**IMPORTANTE** Nesta competição estaremos com uma campanha beneficente que visa a ajuda para os mais necessitados. Também teremos premiação para as 3 pessoas que mais doarem durante os dias de campeonato! Assim, além de nos divertimos, contribuímos para a construção de um mundo melhor. Saiba mais na pagina [Campanha Beneficente](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64648-campanha-beneficente) 💵 **PREMIAÇÃO EM DINHEIRO** 💵 Nesta competição, estaremos realizando a premiação em dinheiro para o pódio da modalidade principal do campeonato, o Clock. Todas as informações estão dispostas na página [Premiação em Dinheiro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64649-premiacao-em-dinheiro) Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista este [vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [regulamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) da WCA antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da primeira modalidade em que vai competir. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Iniciante (primeira competição)', e "Feminino" que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'. 🇬🇧 **English:** Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the Register tab. If you have any problem registering, watch this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA&t). ❗️❗️**IMPORTANT** This competition will feature a charity campaign to help those most in need. We'll also have prizes for the three people who donate the most during the competition! This way, we'll not only have fun, but we'll also contribute to building a better world. Learn more on the [Charity Campaign](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64648-campanha-beneficente) page. 💵 **CASH PRIZES** 💵 In this competition, we will be awarding cash prizes for the podium finishers in the main event, Clock. All information is available on the [Cash Prizes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64649-premiacao-em-dinheiro) page. If this is your first time competing, watch this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) to learn how to compete. Please read the WCA [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the first event you're competing in is scheduled to begin. By registering, you authorize ABRACM, WCA, and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes. We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Beginner (first competition)', and "female" which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.
